_readme: Copy this file to knowledge/sources.json (gitignored) and curate YOUR OWN reliable sources before trading. You are responsible for choosing trustworthy sources. The assistant consults get_knowledge_base before analysis/order proposals, and may PROPOSE additions but only writes them after you confirm with CONFIRM_ADD_SOURCE. Each source: id (slug), title, type (url|dataset|principle|document), url (for url/dataset), category (e.g. macro|on-chain|methodology|risk|news), trust (high|medium|low), notes (free text), enabled (true to surface it), addedBy (user|assistant), addedAt (ISO date). Remove a source by deleting its entry from the file. Set enabled to true once you trust it.
